title: A registered channel reads trace_enabled true before any callback of its own, the framework's handler registered, and still true once one is
notes: Python: channels/base.py Channel.trace_enabled; core/mixins/channel_ops.py register_channel sets the framework handler. In part: every channel of a scenario is registered, so neither a channel holding a user callback alone, without the framework's handler, nor one holding no handler, which reads false, is read.
